ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) in the medial and basal regions transitioning to high-intensity (white) patches on the distal lobe tips, with a macro-level white-to-black pixel distribution ratio of approximately 1:2.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity mass occupying the central 60% of the fluke surface; high-intensity white patches are localized to the distal third of both lobes, with a higher concentration of discrete dark circular blobs (mottling) on the right distal lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 100 degrees and a significant depth relative to the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations most pronounced in the proximal regions adjacent to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the superior edges of both lobes, terminating in acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of dark circular pixel clusters (rosettes) on the white distal background of the right lobe; numerous circular white-ring pixel structures (depicting barnacle attachment sites) distributed across the central dark field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, high-contrast vertical linear disruption is visible on the interior white patch of the right lobe; multiple faint horizontal parallel lines (rake marks) are detected on the medial lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged, non-uniform erosion of the trailing edge margins, particularly at the distal tips; extensive surface pitting consistent with ectoparasitic attachment across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'leopard-spot' pattern of high-contrast dark circular marks concentrated specifically within the high-intensity white field of the right lobe tip.
